free-african-society-founded.description: A dimly lit painted interior of a plain wooden room. A man in a dark coat sits at a rough table writing with a quill in an open ledger, while a circle of Black men and women in plain late-18th-century dress, some in head wraps, look on. A lit candle and a small open box of coins sit on the table, with a window and wooden beams behind. I see no legible text.

walkers-appeal-pamphlet.description: A Black man in a grey waistcoat and rolled white shirt sits at a worn wooden table, stitching a dark garment while a printed sheet lies open on the fabric. Stacks of printed pages sit on the table, with a wooden hand press, ink bottles and a lantern behind him. Dark coats hang on the walls of a dim, candlelit workshop that reads as 19th century.

crandall-school-black-girls.description: A painted schoolroom scene. On the left, a woman in a black dress, white shawl and bonnet writes on a chalkboard. Several girls with dark skin sit at wooden desks in period dresses, writing with quills on slates. Through a tall multi-pane window, a group of men in top hats and dark coats gesture and shout outside, with a few houses and bare trees beyond. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

fourteenth-amendment-ratified.description: A man in a dark coat and bow tie stands on porch steps, reading aloud from a yellowed sheet of paper. Around him, a crowd of Black men, women and children in 19th-century work clothes and headwraps listens intently. An elderly man with a cane sits at lower right. Behind them are brick walls and columns in a shaded, dim setting. The style is an oil-painting look, with no visible text, frame or graphic content.

fifteenth-amendment-ratified.description: An oil-painted scene of several Black men in dark period suits and hats outdoors beside a rough wooden cabin. In the right foreground an older man in a hat and long coat drops a folded paper ballot into a wooden ballot box on a plank table. Others stand in a line behind him, watching. Trees and weathered wood frame the scene. No visible text, no frame, nothing graphic.

wells-southern-horrors.description: A painted interior scene: a woman with hair in a bun and a dark high-collared, puffed-sleeve dress sits at a wooden desk writing with a pen. A lit hanging oil lamp glows above. Stacks of printed sheets and newspapers, an inkwell, and a pen sit on the desk. Behind her are an old iron printing press and shelves of books, with a type case at right. The painting fills the frame edge to edge. No legible text.

gandhi-thrown-off-train.description: A man in a dark turban and dark suit sits hunched on a wooden bench on a dim railway platform at night, head bowed, with a brown suitcase and a bundled sack beside him. A steam locomotive with smoke and an old wooden-panelled carriage are to the right, and a lit lamp under an ornate canopy lights the station building on the left. Two dark figures stand in the background. Painted in a dark oil style, with no visible text and no frame.

du-bois-souls-black-folk.description: An oil-painting style study interior: a rolltop desk with a green-shaded brass lamp, stacks of handwritten pages, a dark bound book, an inkwell and pen, and a pair of spectacles. Bookshelves fill the walls, a leather chair is at the desk, and a hat hangs on the side. No people are visible.

garvey-founds-unia.description: A man in a dark suit and black hat stands in the foreground, looking to the side with a serious expression. Behind him a procession of people in white and dark uniforms marches down a street lined with two-storey wooden colonial-style balconies crowded with onlookers. A drummer in a uniform plays at the left, a red, black and green flag and a white banner with geometric patterns rise in the centre, and a few people raise their arms. The painting is loose, oil-like brushwork that fills the whole image edge to edge.

first-pan-african-congress-paris.description: A man in a dark suit stands at a wooden lectern in a dim, ornate salon with a crystal chandelier, gilt chairs and tall curtained windows, one arm raised as he speaks. Seated and standing rows of Black men in suits fill the room, and a man in an embroidered robe sits at right. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.
